newsitem.title: USA: U.S.A Growth, Web gaming company to merge.
newsitem.headline: U.S.A Growth, Web gaming company to merge.

text.p: U.S.A. Growth Inc and World Wide Web Casinos Inc on Monday announced a formal agreement to merge under a plan that calls for shareholders to receive shares in the new company called Newco.
When the deal is completed, World Wide Web Casinos shareholders and U.S.A. Growth shareholders will own about 94 percent and six percent, respectively, of Newco's shares on a fully diluted basis.
No further financial details about the proposed merger were disclosed in the statement issued by the companies.

The companies estimate it will take six months to complete the requisite review by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and other regulatory matters. Shareholders of each company must also approve the merger.

The agreement also contemplates the extension of the expiration date of outstanding U.S.A. Growth warrants. The warrants will be converted at the same exchange rate at which shares of U.S.A. Growth common stock are to be converted into shares of Newco common stock.
World Wide Web Casinos is based on Antigua in the Caribbean. It is using technology to target the Internet gaming market.
